header: Loading streaming data from OpenSearch Ingestion
content:
You can use Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion to load data into an OpenSearch Service domain.
You conﬁgure your data producers to send data to OpenSearch Ingestion, and it automatically
delivers the data to the collection that you specify. You can also conﬁgure OpenSearch Ingestion to
transform your data before delivering it. For more information, see Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion.

hierarchy.parent: Loading streaming data into Amazon OpenSearch Service
